name: Cursor — Snap Outline
description: iPadOS-style pointer: a soft dot that morphs into a rounded outline hugging whatever button or link you hover, springing on position, size and radius, with a subtle magnetic pull toward the target's centre.
a11y: Purely decorative overlay (aria-hidden); native cursor stays available. Disabled on touch and under reduced motion.
perf: Five spring motion values; one pointermove listener; no React re-renders while moving.
props: Area where the cursor is active.
Selector for elements to snap to.
prompt: Track the pointer inside a container; on pointerover of a matching target read its rect and radius; spring x/y/width/height/radius toward the target rect (plus a small offset toward the pointer for magnetism); otherwise shrink to a 10px dot following the pointer.

name: Cursor — Flashlight
description: X-ray flashlight: a dark top layer has a soft circular hole that trails the pointer with easing, revealing a second layer underneath — hidden messages, blueprints, before/after. Click to widen the beam. Touch and reduced motion get a Reveal toggle.
a11y: Both layers stay in the DOM; a Reveal toggle (aria-pressed) shows the hidden layer for touch and keyboard users.
perf: CSS mask-image driven by three custom properties updated in one rAF loop.
props: What you see in the dark (top layer).
prompt: Stack a cover div over the content and set mask-image: radial-gradient(circle var(--fr) at var(--fx) var(--fy), transparent 70%, #000); lerp --fx/--fy toward the pointer in rAF; animate --fr up on pointerdown.

name: Chart — Bar Race
description: Animated bar-chart race: bars re-rank with layout springs as values change period by period, numbers tween, and the big period label rolls. Play/pause and a scrubber let you jump to any frame.
a11y: Chart has a text summary of the current leader; controls are real buttons and a labelled range input. Reduced motion jumps between frames without springs.
perf: Only the visible top-N bars render; layout animations on transform.
props: One value per frame per series.
prompt: Sort each frame's entries, render the top N as motion.div with layout and key=series so re-ordering animates; width = value / max; tween the numbers; roll the period label with AnimatePresence; add play/pause and a range scrubber.

name: Chart — Live Stream
description: Streaming line chart that scrolls smoothly between ticks: new points arrive every interval while the path translates continuously, the y-range eases to fit, and a pulsing head dot shows the latest value.
a11y: role=img with an aria-label holding the latest value; pause button; reduced motion updates per tick without the scroll.
perf: One SVG path rebuilt per tick; between ticks only a transform changes via rAF.
prompt: Keep a fixed-length buffer, push a random-walk value each tick; draw the path one step wider than the view and translate it left by progress × step inside rAF; ease min/max toward the buffer's range; gradient fill under the line.

name: AI — Voice Call
description: Voice-assistant call screen: a liquid orb that breathes while listening, swirls while thinking and pulses with the voice while speaking, live word-by-word captions, a call timer, mute and hang-up.
a11y: Captions are an aria-live region; state is announced; controls are labelled buttons. Reduced motion keeps the orb static and shows full captions.
perf: Orb animates transform/opacity only; captions reveal one word per tick.
prompt: State machine listening → thinking → speaking over a script; orb = layered blurred gradients whose scale/rotation depend on state; captions reveal word by word; a timer; mute toggles and hang-up ends the call.

name: AI — Plan Graph
description: Agent plan visualiser: a goal node grows a tree of steps; each step's sub-tasks spin then tick off, finished steps collapse into an 'N done' chip, and the next step unfolds — like watching an agent think.
a11y: Plan is an ordered list with status text per item; progress is announced politely. Reduced motion shows the final state.
perf: Small DOM; height animations via layout on a handful of nodes.
prompt: Render the goal, then step nodes connected by a vertical line; a timer advances task index; running tasks show a spinner, done tasks a check; when a step completes collapse its tasks into a chip with layout; loop with a Replay button.

name: Toast — Dynamic Island
description: Dynamic-Island-style notifications: a black pill at the top morphs in width and height to show loading, success or error, with a promise() helper that walks through the states and an optional detail line.
a11y: Island is a role=status live region; dismisses after a timeout but pauses on hover.
perf: One element morphing via layout; icons swap with AnimatePresence.
prompt: Provide context with show(kind,title,detail) and promise(p,{loading,success,error}); render one motion.div with layout and rounded-full; contents keyed by state animate in/out; auto-collapse to a small pill after a delay.

name: Share Sheet
description: A share button that morphs into a full share sheet (shared layoutId): recent people and targets pop in with a stagger, copy-link confirms inline, and the native share sheet is used when the browser has one.
a11y: Sheet is a dialog with focus moved in and Esc to close; buttons are labelled. Reduced motion uses a fade.
perf: One layout morph; pops are transform/opacity.
prompt: Give the trigger and the sheet the same layoutId so the button grows into the panel; stagger avatar and target buttons in; copy uses navigator.clipboard and flips to a check; call navigator.share when available.

name: Button — Slide to Confirm
description: Slide-to-confirm control for risky actions: drag the knob along the track, the fill follows and the label shimmers and fades; past 85% it completes with a check, otherwise it springs back.
a11y: Role=slider with aria-valuenow; Enter/Space/→/End complete it from the keyboard. Reduced motion removes the shimmer.
perf: Drag on one motion value; fill and label opacity are derived transforms.
prompt: Track with a draggable knob constrained to the track; useTransform the knob x into fill width and label opacity; on drag end if x > 85% animate to end and call onConfirm, else spring back; add keyboard handlers.

name: Button — 3D Key
description: Chunky mechanical-key button with a real edge: the cap lifts on hover and sinks to the base on press, with a soft shadow that shrinks and grows. Colour and depth are CSS variables.
a11y: Native button; visible focus ring; reduced motion removes the transitions but keeps the pressed state.
perf: Pure CSS transforms on three span layers.
prompt: Layer three spans in a button: a blurred shadow, a darker edge, and the cap; translate the cap up by --d on rest, further on hover, and to 2px on :active; shrink the shadow as the cap sinks.

name: Tabs — Stretch Indicator
description: Tabs whose pill indicator moves like a caterpillar: the leading edge springs toward the new tab first while the trailing edge lags and catches up, so the pill stretches across the gap and snaps back.
a11y: role=tablist with roving tabindex and arrow-key navigation. Reduced motion jumps the indicator.
perf: Two motion values (left/right edges) on one absolutely positioned span.
prompt: Track left and right edges as separate motion values; when the tab changes animate the leading edge with a stiff spring and the trailing edge with a softer, delayed spring; width = right − left.

name: Menu — 3D Push Drawer
description: Mobile menu that pushes the page back in 3D: the page rotates on Y, slides right and scales down with rounded corners and a deep shadow, revealing a dark menu whose links slide in with a stagger.
a11y: Menu is a nav landmark; closed menu and open page are inert; Esc closes and returns focus to the toggle. Reduced motion: slide only, no rotation.
perf: Transform-only animation on the page wrapper.
prompt: Place the menu behind the page; on open animate the page to x 58%, rotateY −12°, scale .82, radius 28 with perspective on the parent; stagger links in; tap the page to close.

name: Skeleton → Content Morph
description: Skeleton placeholders that dissolve with a blur while the real content resolves in from a blur in the same box — no layout jump — with a shimmer sweeping across the bars while loading.
a11y: Container toggles aria-busy; skeleton is aria-hidden. Reduced motion stops the shimmer and cross-fades.
perf: Grid stacking keeps both states in one cell; filter only during the swap.
prompt: Stack skeleton and content in the same grid cell; exit the skeleton with blur+fade, enter the content from blur(10px) and y 6; shimmer is a gradient span sliding across each bar.

name: Loader — Orbit Dots
description: Atom-style loader: three tilted rings of dots spinning at different speeds and directions around a pulsing core, built with CSS 3D transforms only.
a11y: role=status with a label. Reduced motion shows the static gyroscope.
perf: Pure CSS keyframes on transform; no JS per frame.
prompt: Three preserve-3d wrappers tilted with rotateX/rotateY; inside each, dots placed on a circle and the wrapper spins on Z with different durations; a pulsing core in the middle.

name: Animated Icon Set
description: Six stateful SVG icons with meaningful motion: hamburger ⇄ close, play ⇄ pause path morph, a heart that fills with a spark burst, a ringing bell with a badge, copy → check and sun ⇄ moon.
a11y: Each icon is a toggle button with aria-pressed and a label. Reduced motion switches state without motion.
perf: Small SVGs animating d, transform and pathLength.
prompt: Build each icon as a button around a 24×24 stroke SVG; animate per-element transforms with springs (menu), interpolate equal-point paths (play/pause), pathLength (check), and a mask circle (moon).

name: SVG — Live Route Map
description: Delivery-tracking map: a stylised street grid, the route draws itself, a courier marker follows the path and turns to its heading, stops light up as it passes and an ETA counts down.
a11y: role=img with an aria-label carrying the ETA. Reduced motion shows the completed route.
perf: getPointAtLength each frame on one path; the marker is a single transformed group.
prompt: Draw the route with pathLength=1 and animate dashoffset; each frame get the point at progress × length plus a point 1px ahead for the heading; light stops whose position ≤ progress; derive the ETA.

name: Transition — Ink Blot
description: Page transition where ink spills from the exact point you clicked: a turbulence-displaced SVG circle grows into a wobbly blot that floods the screen, the page swaps, then the blot drains to the opposite corner.
a11y: Overlay is aria-hidden; nav uses aria-current. Reduced motion swaps instantly.
perf: One SVG circle with feTurbulence + feDisplacementMap; only r and cx/cy change.
prompt: On click store the pointer position, animate an SVG circle's radius to cover the farthest corner with a displacement filter for ragged edges, swap the page, move the origin to the mirrored point and shrink the radius back to 0.

name: Transition — Stairs
description: Staircase page transition: vertical columns drop in one after another, a big index number appears while the page swaps under cover, then the columns keep falling out the bottom in the same order.
a11y: Columns are decorative; nav uses aria-current. Reduced motion swaps instantly.
perf: N transformed divs; no layout work.
prompt: Render N flex columns with initial y -100%, animate to 0 with a per-column delay, swap the page once all are down, then exit to y 100% with the same stagger.

name: Polaroid Stack
description: A messy pile of polaroids with hand-written captions. Fling the top photo in any direction and it flies off and slides back in at the bottom while the rest shuffle up with new tilts.
a11y: Group is focusable with ←/→ and labelled with the current caption; Back/Next buttons. Reduced motion cycles without the throw.
perf: At most 4 cards rendered; drag on one motion value.
prompt: Keep an order array; render the first four with depth-based scale/rotate; the top card drags on x with rotate derived from x; on a throw past a threshold rotate the order and exit the card off-screen.

name: Thumbnail Reel
description: Hero image with a filmstrip of thumbnails: the active thumb widens into a pill with a filling progress bar while the hero slowly zooms; when it fills, the next slide cross-fades in. Hover pauses.
a11y: Thumbnails are a tablist; title is aria-live; hover and focus pause autoplay. Reduced motion: no zoom, no autoplay.
perf: Flex-grow springs on 5 buttons; one image transform per slide.
prompt: Cross-fade the hero with AnimatePresence and a long linear scale from 1.08 to 1; animate each thumb's flexGrow (4 when active); a scaleX progress bar over interval seconds; a timeout advances the index.
